title: Zero Ad Spend Content Acquisition
content: That single LinkedIn post drove 80% of our pipeline. One post. No ads. Just a raw story with real numbers. We didn't do a massive campaign. We didn't hire an agency. I just sat down on a Tuesday night and wrote out the exact post-mortem of how we lost our biggest client, and what we did next. Transparency is the highest leverage marketing channel in 2026.

title: Prefactoring Over Rewriting
content: Before you write a single line of new feature code, make the change easy. Then make the easy change. Most developers spend 80% of their time fighting their own codebase because they rushed to implement the feature without cleaning the foundation first. We spent 2 hours refactoring our routing layer yesterday. Today, adding Firecrawl scraping took 10 minutes. Slow down to speed up.

title: The Death of Corporate Copy
content: Most B2B content is absolute slop. If you read a post and it contains 'delve', 'tapestry', or 'landscape', your brain immediately tunes it out. Why? Because it sounds like a machine wrote it. Start writing like you are texting a friend. Use contractions. Cut sentences short. Give actual numbers instead of saying 'significant growth'. The human internet is fighting back.
